description: Developer fragment format; not an OpenAPI document. Builders merge schemas and operations into docs/openapi.json. Use authoritative handlers/model DTOs. Canonical user paths automatically expand into platform /b/{brandCode} aliases.

operationFields.path: Full canonical path, e.g. /api/v1/admin/join-codes; user domain path /api/v1/me (do not add /b aliases).
operationFields.idempotency: true for mutations using engine; false for read-only POST simulations
operationFields.requestBody: JSON schema object or local $ref; omitted for GET
operationFields.data: Success data JSON schema object or local $ref; must reflect actual emitted DTO. Mutually exclusive with successContent; the builder wraps this in the standard JSON success envelope
operationFields.successContent: Mutually exclusive with data. Nonempty OpenAPI response content map keyed by media type; every media entry must declare a schema. Use an explicit binary string schema for file downloads
operationFields.successHeaders: Additional OpenAPI response headers for the success response, merged with standard response headers
operationFields.successDescription: Description of the successful response, including its representation and relevant completion guarantees
operationFields.additionalErrorStatuses: Additional supported HTTP error status codes; builder emits the standard JSON ErrorResponse for each declared status
operationFields.parameters: OpenAPI query/header parameter objects. Path variables are filled by builder. Do not add shared Idempotency-Key/Origin/X-Request-ID headers.
operationFields.brandHeader: true when admin operation actually requires X-Brand-ID; false for admin auth/me/brands/logout global operations
operationFields.permissions: Array of authoritative grant keys, descriptive only; use description for any/all or special super-admin restrictions
operationFields.description: Semantics, actual safety constraints, and remaining stubs, not future capabilities

fragmentModule: Export const schemas = {...}; export const operations = [{...}]. Prefix domain-specific schema names to prevent collisions; local refs #/components/schemas/Name. No bare unknown object for concrete inputs/DTOs. True opaque AST/JSONB may use ArbitraryJSON with explanation. Required keys from actual JSON emission; optional input not made falsely mandatory. Nullable anyOf(ref,null) or type:[string,null] per OAS3.1.1. Bodies closed when server rejects unknown fields. Do not publish secrets, code from licenses, or actual credentials. No runtime HTTP or filesystem mutations.
